status: PROPOSED. Not owner-confirmed. Fixed before any human label exists. A starting point, not a safety claim.
owner_confirmation: NONE RECORDED. The owner confirms by passing this file's thresholds_sha256 to the merge command; nothing in this file records approval.
editing_rule: Any edit changes thresholds_sha256 and breaks the pinned test. A change after labels exist invalidates the run; start a new version instead.

inter_labeller.on_failure: stop; revise rubric guidance; relabel with a new blind ordering; never lower these numbers

adjudicated_set.below_minimum: report as indicative only; make no calibration claim

judge_vs_adjudicated.basis: adjudicated PASS/FAIL cases for which the judge gave a determinate verdict

false_positive.definition: judge PASS on adjudicated FAIL; denominator is ALL adjudicated FAIL cases (a judge UNKNOWN or failure is not hidden)

false_negative.definition: judge FAIL on adjudicated PASS; denominator is ALL adjudicated PASS cases

unknown_handling.adjudicated_unknown: excluded from agreement and error rates; reported separately
unknown_handling.dimension_not_applicable_reason: reported as its own count; not pooled with context_insufficient or question_missing

repeatability.unstable_definition: a case whose verdict (PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN) is not identical across all repeats
